title: Dutchism
description: A mod that add the Netherlands to MineCraft
body:
### Dutchism
Environment: NeoForge

📖 What's this mod?
> Dutchism is a **mod** wich main goal is to add specialties of the Netherlands to minecraft.
> Features wich will be added include 'Stroopwafels' and more!

✅ Features:
- Stoopwafels
- Stroopwafel villager
- Klompen

📖 Usage
Using this mod is very simple!

Install it in your mods folder (and add Sodium if wanted for better performances).

It will work as-is.

Need help? Come check out my Discord server.

📖 Is there an API? How to use it as a developer?
No.

📖 How does it work internally?
It add new textures and functionallitys

📖 Compatibility
Almost every mod is compatible. I haven't seen one that is not.
